lastProgressReport.summary: Official curriculum questions 1-5 and 7 are rendered as pages 42-47, source-locked and machine-verified. Claude Code reconciled the diagram-dependent figures against the canonical jerusalem2 scans and corrected Q1 part ב to the true axial cross-section (AB = top-base diameter), with Q3 geometry and the Q4 shortest/longest cases verified. SSOT §19 continuous-scroll preview is now a binding, itemised requirement and index.html renders all 47 pages in continuous scroll by default; ssot-qa.mjs hardened to enforce a single requirements authority. Remaining work is the final pixel-level reconciliation of Q4's two middle triangles plus G-10, which cannot close while the SSOT explicitly remains open until Yaniv says the specification is finished.
